purpose: Explicit, testable circuit breakers. Each trigger is evaluable against .orchestration/runs/<WORK-ID>/status.json and its evidence records. Agents MUST NOT edit this file to get past a breaker.
enforcement_note: tools/breaker-check evaluates attempt-limit, no-progress, evidence-conflict, gate-encountered and handoff-insufficient against a run's status.json (via `breaker-check --run-dir ...`), and budget-exceeded against tools/agent-metrics (via `--ticket`). It is invoked from .claude/agents/lead.md and all four sdlc-*-workflow skills before any retry is granted. scope-expansion is not mechanically checked here — .claude/hooks/gate-guard.py blocks the Bash-detectable subset of gates.json instead (a related but separate concern), and genuine scope-expansion still requires human judgement.

breakers.trips_when: two consecutive attempts share an unchanged failure signal
an agent claim of PASS conflicts with an evidence record showing FAIL, or cites evidence that does not exist
an action matches a gate in gates.json
a required handoff field is missing, or references an evidence path that does not exist
cumulative cost_usd for the ticket (from tools/agent-metrics report --json) exceeds budget-limits.json's ceiling_usd
